title: LinkedIn Video Downloader
summary: Fast and easy LinkedIn video downloader. Save Linkedin media in just a few taps!
description:
Looking to download videos, pdfs, images or gifs from LinkedIn for offline viewing? Our LinkedIn Video Downloader app is here to simplify the process. With just a few taps, you can save LinkedIn media directly to your device in high quality.

Features:

⭐ Fast and easy video, pdf, image & gif downloads from LinkedIn
⭐ Save videos, pdfs, images & gifs in high quality
⭐ View and play saved media with in-built player/viewer
⭐ Simple and user-friendly interface
⭐ Queue downloads and download them at your convenience

How to use:

Method 1: Direct Sharing

1️⃣ Open LinkedIn and find the post with the media you want to download.
2️⃣ Tap the three vertical dots on the post and select "Share via."
3️⃣ Choose LinkedDown from the sharing options. The media will be downloaded automatically.

Method 2: Manual Link Copy

1️⃣ Open LinkedIn in your browser and locate the media post.
2️⃣ Tap the three vertical dots on the post and select "Share via," then choose "Copy link."
3️⃣ Open the LinkedDown app, paste the link, and get the media downloaded.

Enjoy seamless video, image/gif & pdf downloads without the need for complicated steps or additional software. Stay connected with the content you love from LinkedIn, anytime and anywhere!

Note: 
*This app is not affiliated with LinkedIn. Please ensure you have the right to download and share content before using the app.
